verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an online account-based tax portal, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no bulk or full-account export in open formats. The XML schemas and batch files cover inbound filing and enrollment, and the history and lookup pages offer viewing, not portable export, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
